# Pinned window-shape and variable-font support

Base: published `gpui-pre-wgpu` **0.3.11**. Original licenses are retained.
Crate archive SHA-256: `211cf352de1a0b0c9bea3f105df5572ce1d2c899389b924a888e5af36b50f93d`.
`UPSTREAM-SHA256.json` records the original published files.

Local change: the platform supplies current physical client-frame bounds and
corner radii through `WgpuRenderer::set_client_frame`. A frame-wide shader mask
clips quads, paths, images, underlines, surfaces and text. Drop shadows retain
their independently rounded geometry outside the frame. Offscreen path
rasterization remains unmasked; its final composition is clipped. Zero radii
leave rendering unchanged. No general element-mask API or theme policy changes.

`cargo test --manifest-path vendor/gpui-pre-wgpu/Cargo.toml --features test-support --test client_frame` performs GPU pixel readback for
opaque children, premultiplied paths, antialiasing, tiled corners, disabled clipping and external
shadows. The application must also be exercised at different sizes/scales and
through maximize/restore on a real compositor. Remove the override after a
reviewed upstream implementation passes the same checks.

The published manifest omits the Naga test dependency used by upstream shader
validation tests; the path override restores it for the dedicated integration test. The archive also omits font fixtures required
by unrelated upstream unit tests; the integration target avoids compiling them.

The standalone test lockfile is aligned with the enclosing application lockfile
so GPU acceptance uses the application dependency versions.

The CosmicText adapter also preserves the `wght` axis of installed variable
fonts. Matching uses the face's supported range; each resolved weight has a
separate font/glyph-cache identity. Shaping, Swash metrics and rasterization
receive the same coordinates, including fallback glyphs. Static faces retain
their actual weight and identity. This fixes Bold resolving to Regular for
variable desktop fonts such as Adwaita Sans without bundling replacement fonts.

`cargo test --manifest-path vendor/gpui-pre-wgpu/Cargo.toml --test variable_font`
checks matching, clamping, advance widths, shaping, raster coverage, cache
isolation and variable fallback glyphs. Also run it with `--features font-kit`.
Its tiny fonts contain original rectangles, generated by `tests/fonts/generate.py`;
they contain no third-party artwork and are not application assets.
